messages:
taylor: Heads-up — blocking PR #10456 (kv-cache OOM mitigation). CI is green but policy requires two approvers before the 22:00 UTC cutoff. ETA ~20m. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/10456
kevin: can you paste a 1-2 line risk summary?
taylor: risk summary: reduces peak KV memory by chunking prefetch; main risk is a small latency bump on long sequences in the dedupe path. smoke + perf tests looked fine on staging.
lana: I'll take a look now :eyes:
sre-jordan: if this goes in, who owns the smoke verification & rollback? need a named lead for canary.
taylor: @lana can run the staging smoke after merge; @kevin can watch logs/metrics and trigger rollback; i'm on-call for immediate backout if anything flares.
lana: quick read — left a tiny null-check comment, pushing a one-line fix.
deploy-bot: Reminder: release freeze in effect. Merge allowed only with 2 approvals. Scheduled cutover window opens 22:00 UTC.
jen: small naming nit but non-blocking, LGTM from my side.
kevin: re-reviewed, tests look good. approving now :thumbsup: (left a minor question inline)
lana: fix pushed and CI retriggered. approving after CI.
taylor: thanks — once we have two approvals i'll merge and kick the canary.
deploy-bot: CI green (rerun) — all checks passed.
lana: Approving — two approvers satisfied, go ahead.
taylor: Merging into release branch in ~2m. will post canary status here.
sre-jordan: standing by to run the smoke checklist post-merge.
deploy-bot: merge completed by taylor at 22:03 UTC (automated note). Canary rollout started.
